Package com.spyj.listener

Class ClassListener

java.lang.Object
com.spyj.listener.ClassListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.event.ClassListener
public class ClassListener extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.event.ClassListener
Listens for BlueJ class lifecycle events and records them as CLASS_CREATED, CLASS_MODIFIED, and CLASS_DELETED telemetry events. Implements the BlueJ ClassListener API.

Class creation is distinguished from modification by tracking the set of class files already seen. The first time a class file is observed it is recorded as CLASS_CREATED; all subsequent state changes for that file are recorded as CLASS_MODIFIED.

When a project is opened, addExistingClasses(BPackage) must be called to pre-populate the internal tracking set so that pre-existing classes are not misreported as newly created.

Author:
Mykel Dedier

  • Method Details

    • addExistingClasses

      public void addExistingClasses(bluej.extensions2.BPackage bPackage)
      Pre-populates the internal tracking set with the classes that already exist in the given package. This prevents pre-existing classes from being reported as CLASS_CREATED when their state is first observed after a project opens. Called by ProjectListener.packageOpened(PackageEvent) on project open.
      Parameters:
      bPackage - the BlueJ package whose existing classes should be registered

    • classStateChanged

      public void classStateChanged(bluej.extensions2.event.ClassEvent e)
      Called by BlueJ when a class's state changes (e.g. it is saved or compiled). Records a CLASS_CREATED event the first time the class file is seen, or a CLASS_MODIFIED event for all subsequent state changes.
      Specified by:
      classStateChanged in interface bluej.extensions2.event.ClassListener
      Parameters:
      e - the BlueJ class event

    • classRemoved

      public void classRemoved(bluej.extensions2.event.ClassEvent e)
      Called by BlueJ when a class is deleted from the project. Records a CLASS_DELETED event and removes the class file from the tracking set.
      Specified by:
      classRemoved in interface bluej.extensions2.event.ClassListener
      Parameters:
      e - the BlueJ class event

    • classNameChanged

      public void classNameChanged(bluej.extensions2.event.ClassEvent e)
      Called by BlueJ when a class is renamed. Records a CLASS_MODIFIED event that includes both the new and old class names, and updates the internal tracking set to reflect the new file path.
      Specified by:
      classNameChanged in interface bluej.extensions2.event.ClassListener
      Parameters:
      e - the BlueJ class event containing the old and new class names
